title: Uppāde
text: 1--2. Sāvatthi || || Tatravoca || || 3. Pañcimāni bhikkhave indriyāni bhāvitāni bahulīkatāni anuppannāni uppajjanti naññatra sugatavinayā || || 4. Katamāni pañca || || Saddhindriyaṃ viriyindriyaṃ satindriyaṃ. samādhindriyam paññindriyam || || Imāni kho bhikkhave pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni bahulīkatāni anuppannāni uppajjanti nāññatra sugatavinayā ti || || Vaggo chaṭṭho || || Tassuddānaṃ || || Sālam Mallikaṃ Sekho ca || Pade Sāre Patiṭṭhito || Brahma Sūkarakhatāya || Uppāde apare duve ti || || [page 236] 236 Indriya-Saṃyuttam XLVIII. CHAPTER VII. BODHIPAKKHIYAVAGGO SATTAMO.
